verdicts.rationale: The coverage check found no public API or developer docs (/api returns 404 and the legacy developer site shows only an investor sign-in), and the only integration claim is marketing language about connecting business applications (c8), which does not show an API.
verdicts.missing: Any public API reference, developer documentation or vendor statement that an API exists for reading or changing core records.

verdicts.rationale: InvestNext's own help center has an MCP collection (p3), a help article on connecting InvestNext MCP to Claude that says the server is a paid add-on to be enabled on the account (c5), and an FAQ describing the vendor's read-only, permission-respecting, paginated server (c4, c6, c7).
verdicts.missing: The pack quotes only the paid-add-on prerequisite from the connection article, not the connection steps themselves (server URL, authentication), nor which record types the read-only server exposes.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no SDK, CLI or public code repository, and the coverage check found no developer documentation at all.
verdicts.missing: Any vendor-maintained SDK or CLI on a package registry or public repository, or even code samples.

verdicts.rationale: The only event-style mechanism shown is Zapier connections that push InvestNext data to the rest of a sponsor's stack, listed as a Pro-plan feature (c10, c9, c2), with no native webhooks or event subscriptions documented.
verdicts.missing: Which Zapier triggers or events exist and which records they cover, and any native webhook or event-subscription documentation; the Zapier evidence is marketing copy.

verdicts.rationale: The only access path shown is the MCP, which acts with the connecting user's existing InvestNext permissions and cannot create, update or delete records (c6, c4), but no API keys, OAuth clients or configurable scopes are documented.
verdicts.missing: How the MCP authenticates, whether an agent can get its own key or OAuth client, and any scopes or roles that narrow a credential below a user's full web-app access.

verdicts.rationale: No OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL or other machine-readable spec appears in the pack, and the coverage check found no public API for one to describe.
verdicts.missing: Any machine-readable API specification, public or behind a login.

verdicts.rationale: A probe found an llms.txt for the help center, which is the product's documentation (p2: GET 200, 55,373 bytes, headed 'InvestNext Help Center'), alongside a Yoast-generated llms.txt for the marketing site (p1, c11).
verdicts.missing: The pack shows only the help-center llms.txt's heading and size, not which articles it lists, and does not show Markdown versions of individual pages.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no sandbox, test mode or developer environment, and na does not apply because the product holds customers' own records rather than published data.
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve or on-request sandbox, test account or developer environment.

verdicts.rationale: The pack documents no CSV, Excel or JSON export or download; the only data-out paths shown are paged MCP reads (c7) and Pro-plan Zapier pushes (c10), neither presented as a bulk export.
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve export or download of records in an open format, or documentation of one.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no sign-up or free trial, and both plans on the pricing page lead to 'Get pricing' requests priced on equity under management (c1).
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve sign-up, free trial or account-creation flow that skips a sales conversation.

verdicts.rationale: Base and Pro plan prices are withheld behind 'Get pricing' requests based on equity under management (c1), and the only published figure is the ACH fee of 0.03% plus 25 cents per payment, capped at $25 (c3).
verdicts.missing: Any subscription price, starting price or equity-under-management rate for the Base or Pro plan a small sponsor would buy.

verdicts.rationale: No API is documented and the MCP is read-only and cannot create records (c4), while Zapier is described only as pushing InvestNext data out (c10), so nothing shows an agent creating investors or sending subscription documents.
verdicts.missing: API or integration documentation for creating investor records or starting subscription documents.

verdicts.rationale: No API is documented and the read-only MCP cannot create records (c4), so nothing in the pack shows an agent posting or reading distributions or generating investor notices.
verdicts.missing: API documentation for creating or reading distributions and for generating or sending investor notices.

verdicts.rationale: No API endpoint or documented export is shown, and although the read-only MCP returns paged lists of records the user can already see (c6, c7), the pack never shows it returns investors, commitments or contributions.
verdicts.missing: Any API endpoint, MCP tool list or documented export that returns investors, commitments and contributions as structured data.

verdicts.rationale: No API is documented and the read-only MCP cannot create records (c4), and nothing in the pack shows capital calls being issued or investor funding status being read.
verdicts.missing: API documentation for creating capital calls and reading each investor's funding status.
